## 9d6ff77830f1

**Canonical branch is unreachable and rejected.** The official test input has
zero color-1 cells in row 0, so `k = 0` and the correct target is the zero-hole
object. The generator declares `k_holes` as only `1|2|3`, samples only 1–3
markers, and its `self_check` returns
`["no color-1 marker cells in row 0"]` for that canonical test input.

Therefore every synthetic example teaches that at least one marker exists and
that the target has a positive hole count, while the held-out canonical query
requires the missing zero-marker/zero-hole branch. Extend the axis to include
`k=0`, schedule that branch into lessons, and require `self_check` to accept all
canonical train/test inputs. No source change was made as part of this audit.
